visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person's hand points toward a large white overhead sign featuring the red and blue Nishimatsuya rabbit logo within a brightly lit, cavernous exhibition hall. Diverse shoppers in casual clothing and masks walk through wide aisles. The camera pans across rows of baby clothes on racks and shelves stocked with childcare products. (2) Close-up shots focus on baby onesies in various colors and patterns, wrapped in clear plastic on hangers with visible price tags. The camera transitions to shelves containing Japanese-branded detergents, feeding bottles, and teethers. The hand frequently points to specific items like Anpanman-themed toys and KOB glass bottles under bright overhead lighting. (3) The camera captures a wide view of a bargain bin area where a female customer is browsing folded garments. More racks of thicker winter clothing for babies are shown, accompanied by promotional posters with Chinese text. The footage concludes with a final pan of the busy exhibition environment and the Nishimatsuya booth exterior.

(2) As the narrator discusses clothing prices and bundle deals, his pitch variability increases to emphasize the savings. The music maintains a steady percussive beat. There are faint background murmurs of other shoppers, but the primary vocal is dominant and authoritative. (3) The narrator shifts to discussing specific Japanese products like bottles and toys. The vocal tone is friendly and informative. No significant technical distortion is present; the mix is professionally balanced between speech and music. (4) The audio concludes with logistical information about the venue. The music slightly swells in volume as the speech ends, providing a clear wrap-up. The final phrases maintain the same high energy and positive valence seen throughout the video.
